name: customer-service-skills
description: Skills for the Customer Service team. Holds upload-documents, which builds the workbook that attaches a folder of documents onto items that already exist in a Worldmaker app, reading each document to decide what kind of document it is; extract-document-text, which converts those document files to Markdown under uv, renders the pages of scanned PDFs that hold no text, and reads those pages with OCR on request; extract-composition-from-documents, which reads a folder of supplier documents and says what each raw material is made of, taking every composition from the one document that states it; and ask-worldover, which guides a person through getting a customer's data and documents into their Worldmaker app and says which screen and control to use at each step.
